Job description:
 As a Service Desk specializing in Dutch and German languages, you will serve as the first point of contact for end-user technical issues and requests. You will play a pivotal role in resolving technical challenges, upholding service level agreements (SLAs), and supporting HCLTech’s reputation for excellence in IT support across multiple client environments. 
 Responsibilities
Act as the initial point of contact for all end-user reported technical issues and service requests, providing support in Dutch, German, and English
Take end-to-end ownership of user incidents and requests, ensuring timely resolution and thorough follow-up as per process requirements.
Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Remote Support Engineering or Field Engineering teams, as appropriate.
Monitor and maintain call quality, response times, and adherence to agreed SLAs, driving continuous improvement in service delivery.
Accurately document and update all customer interactions and case details in the system.
Provide technical support and customer service across multiple client accounts, upholding professionalism and client satisfaction.
Contribute to knowledge base updates, coach and train new team members, and participate in ongoing learning activities.
Analyze recurring issues, perform root cause analysis, and support process improvements.
Ensure compliance with quality standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies.
Strive for high customer satisfaction through first-call resolution and reduced case re-open rates.
Profile description:
 Requirements:
Phone support experience necessary.
Proficiency in both (C1) Dutch and German languages (verbal and written).
Willingness and flexibility to work in a 24/7 shift environment .
Technical helpdesk or technical call center experience is necessary.
Disciplined, systematic problem solving skills required.
Hands-on work experience with the following:
Windows Operating systems
Windows10. Knowledge on MAC (Good to have) .
Experience and knowledge of supporting google suite like Google drive, Google meet, Gmail etc.
ITSM ticketing tools such as Remedy, HP Service Center, Service Now.
User account creation for Active Directory, Exchange Mailboxes, Distribution lists.
Remote desktop connectivity applications like SMS, Bomgar, WebEx, Live Meeting, and Windows Native tools.
Knowledge of Clinical apps like Cerner, All Scripts, "eHR" .
Internet browsers (e.g. Explorer, Chrome, Firefox).
VPN and remote dial-in users.
Support for laptop, desktops, and printers.
Smartphone Support - Iphone and Android.
 Others: Adobe Acrobat and other common desktop applications like WinZip, etc.
We offer:
 Benefits:
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform (possibility of choosing flexible benefits like meal tickets, medical coverage for employees and dependents at Regina Maria, private pension, sport subscription, etc.)
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
Eyeglasses cost reimbursement: 1500 RON to be claimed every 3 years
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to
pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
